svg.title: Jastrow data pipeline: the import flow
svg.text: Jastrow data pipeline — the import flow (spec 2026-09-13 §3)
Yes: refuse to write; read the report
steps 1–5 and the report; nothing written.
base = entry data as last written (tree id) · ours = entry data now
theirs = import(new export). Three-way merge per entry;
on a schedule: fetch to temp, import dry,
diff the report against the committed one,
writes; committed with the entry data
